what: Elem-stílus stúdió — E1 átváltva C-re, mentve: the studio right after a variant was saved.
why: Saving a variant rewrites the look of that element for EVERY user of the dev database. No capture saves one: the PUT is answered here, and the styles read that follows carries the new letter.
how: PUT /ui/element-styles/:id answers 200 (backend/src/theme/routes.js); the page does not read the body, so the fixture sends none. The letter in the read after it is the one the script picked.
